scope: Exact-ID manual semantic review of generic Cleanup; no name propagation

cases.title: Aldarium
cases.rationale: Purchased alchemical ingredient combined with unfinished potions to make goading and prayer regeneration potions; primary Herblore secondary, not generic review.

cases.title: Demonic tallow
cases.rationale: Tallow combines with unfinished torstol potion to create surge potion; boss-drop provenance does not erase the repeatable ingredient role.

cases.title: Garlic
cases.rationale: Non-edible garlic has repeatable Guthix balance potion and Cooking uses alongside several quests. Place with Herblore inputs under the preset secondary policy; preserve its other roles.

cases.title: Nihil shard
cases.semanticExcerpt: 250 Nihil shards are required to create a [[Zaryte crossbow]]
cases.rationale: Shard is a weapon component and a precursor crushed into a potion secondary. Use the resource material stage as primary; retain the Herblore input role and boss provenance.

cases.title: Araxyte venom sac
cases.semanticExcerpt: secondary ingredient]] used to create [[extended anti-venom+]]
cases.rationale: The raw sac upgrades anti-venom+ doses and is also eaten for poison/venom protection with self damage. Primary Herblore secondary under the raw-ingredient workflow policy; preserve both consumable effects.

cases.title: Strange fruit
cases.semanticExcerpt: It can be eaten to cure poison, venom, and restore 30% run energy
cases.rationale: Edible utility consumable belongs with supplies despite restoring no Hitpoints. Preserve run-energy and poison/venom cure roles; random-event provenance does not make it Cleanup.

cases.title: Spinach roll
